deletion.title: Delete Account
deletion.intro: Under Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law, you may request deletion of your account and personal data. Our team reviews the request first, and it is processed no sooner than 72 hours after you submit it; you can withdraw it during that time. Your profile, contacts, address, and pilgrim data and documents are deleted permanently; transaction records (codes and amounts) are kept without your identity as required by law and tax rules. Ongoing bookings or unfinished refunds must be completed first.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.draftTitle: DRAFT — requires legal review before go-live.
privacy.draftBody: This page is an initial framework for compliance with Indonesia’s Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP) and has not yet been verified by {company}’s legal counsel.
privacy.collectIntro: To process Hajj & Umrah bookings (visa, hotel, transport, muthowif, catering), we collect:

categories.identity: Full name, email, WhatsApp number, and address
categories.documents: Passport number, ID card (KTP/NIK), and Family Card (documents required for visa/Hajj-Umrah)
categories.health: Vaccination certificates and health history relevant to the trip
categories.payment: Payment data (transfer receipts) — not including your card or bank account numbers

privacy.purposeBody: Data is used solely to process your bookings: visa processing, hotel/transport/muthowif reservations, payment confirmation, and trip-related communication (WhatsApp/email). We do not sell your personal data to third parties.
privacy.storageBody: Documents (passport, ID card, Family Card, vaccination certificate) are stored in private storage and can only be accessed through temporary links (presigned URLs) that expire automatically. Data is never written to application logs.
privacy.rightsTitle: 4. Your Rights as a Data Subject
privacy.rightsBody: Under the UU PDP, you have the right to access, correct, and request deletion of your personal data. To request account deletion, use the "{button}" button on your Profile page after signing in. Requests are processed manually because some data (transaction history) must be retained for legal and tax purposes.
